key_highlights: ASX shed $90bn in a week amid RBA rate-rise fears and oil price surge, signalling sharp risk-off rotation
AUD weakened materially as growth scare builds, pressuring import-dependent sectors and commodity exporters
Iron ore entering 'bloodletting' phase, directly threatening BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX earnings trajectories
Oil price spike (price suppression failure) lifts fuel costs by ~30c/L, pressuring Qantas.AX, airline sector, and inflation outlook
ANZ.AX post-3,500-job-axing restructuring faces execution risk; bank mortgage war persists despite rate-hike threats
Housing market shows no spring bounce; auction volumes weak, prices under pressure, first-home buyers surging
Mining cap-raise activity intensifies (Canaccord-led), signalling capital stress in junior/intermediate miners
Global AI sector sees top executives (Amodei, Altman, Musk) call for slowdown, creating volatility in tech-linked ASX names
Santos.AX preservation deemed a national sacrifice, raising questions on energy security and dividend sustainability
Superannuation system under political scrutiny; pensioners face private health insurance cost shifts

sectors.trend: Iron ore in active 'bloodletting' phase; gold underperforming ('schmould'); junior miners scrambling for capital via cap raises. Commodity complex broadly under pressure.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin compression. Sunstone Metals, Manuka Resources, PolarX showing relative strength but cap-raise dilution risk is elevated. Gold miners (NVA.AX, GSG.AX) lack a safe-haven bid as oil-driven inflation dominates.

sectors.trend: Mortgage war continues despite rate-hike threats; ANZ.AX restructuring (3,500 jobs cut) signals structural cost pressure. Housing credit growth slowing as auction market fails to bounce.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX, ANZ.AX face NIM pressure from rate volatility. Weak housing cycle caps credit growth. ANZ.AX execution risk on grand plan is a near-term overhang.

sectors.trend: Oil price surge as suppression fails; fuel prices rising 30c/L. Santos.AX preservation framed as national sacrifice, raising dividend and capex sustainability questions.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, STO.AX benefit from oil upside but face political capex constraints. Qantas.AX, airline sector hit by fuel cost inflation. Energy transition (wind farm proposals) adds long-term structural risk to thermal coal.

sectors.trend: Housing price weakness, rising fuel costs, and tax burden ('drowning in taxes') squeeze household budgets. First-home buyer surge is volume-driven but affordability-constrained.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WBC.AX (retail) face margin pressure. REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) under pressure from rate fears and weak occupancy. Consumer staples defensive but growth limited.

sectors.trend: Private health insurance cost shifts onto pensioners; superannuation system under political attack from populists. CSL.AX remains a global anchor but sector policy risk rising.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX, HIC.AX face regulatory overhang. Super fund managers (HUB.AX, PPA.AX) navigate political pressure on fund structure. Defensive allocation remains warranted.

sectors.trend: Global AI leaders (Amodei, Altman, Musk) call for development slowdown; Trump dismisses concerns. Nvidia, Intel, AMD in focus. ASX tech exposure limited but sentiment spillover exists.
sectors.implications: ASX-listed tech (W1.AX, XRO.AX, NEG.AX) face sentiment volatility. AI slowdown narrative could reduce capex cycles, indirectly affecting data-centre REITs and power demand.

key_themes: ASX $90bn weekly drawdown driven by rate fears + oil spike
AUD weakness amid growth scare; commodity exporters under pressure
Iron ore structural decline; mining cap-raise dilution cycle
Oil price surge pressuring inflation, fuel costs, and airline margins
Housing market correction with no spring bounce; first-home buyer surge
Bank sector: mortgage war vs. rate-hike tension; ANZ restructuring
Superannuation and private health policy under political attack
Global AI slowdown debate creating tech-sector uncertainty
Santos preservation as national energy policy priority
Geopolitical risk: Russia-Ukraine border strike, BRICS expansion, Arctic shipping

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate hike / inflation resurgence from oil spike
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce duration in rate-sensitive REITs and growth equities; favour fixed-income ladders and short-duration credit.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore price collapse / China demand weakness
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; rotate into gold or energy hedges. Monitor Chinese stimulus signals.
Hedge AUD exposure; favour export-oriented earnings (mining, agribusiness) over import-dependent consumer names.
Monitor bank NPL trends; reduce REIT exposure; favour defensive consumer staples.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Geopolitical escalation (Russia-Poland border, BRICS, Arctic shipping)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Maintain 5-10% gold allocation; monitor LNG and energy supply-chain disruption risk.
Diversify away from single-sector super fund exposure; monitor HUB.AX, PPA.AX policy risk.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight energy (WDS.AX, STO.AX) on oil price surge and fuel cost inflation
opportunities.rationale: Oil price suppression failure creates multi-quarter upside for Australian upstream producers; fuel cost pass-through supports margins.

opportunities.recommendation: Selective mining cap-raise participation in quality juniors
opportunities.rationale: Canaccord-led cap raises signal capital formation in Sunstone Metals, Manuka Resources, PolarX; entry points improving in a risk-off tape.

opportunities.recommendation: Defensive tilt to CSL.AX and healthcare on policy uncertainty
opportunities.rationale: CSL.AX retains global franchise; healthcare sector benefits from rate-cut expectations if growth scare materialises.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce exposure to iron ore majors and rate-sensitive REITs
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore bloodletting and $90bn ASX drawdown signal continued downside; REITs pressured by rate fears and weak housing.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD weakness; increase cash or short-duration bond allocation
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD 'smashed' on growth scare; import-cost inflation risks further RBA tightening, pressuring equities.
3,500-job cut execution risk; mortgage war margin pressure; grand plan 'has a long way to go'.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure over 1-3 months. Oil-driven inflation risks a further RBA hike, capping rate-cut expectations. Iron ore weakness and AUD depreciation weigh on materials and financials. Housing data remains soft. Expect elevated volatility around Fed meeting and RBA commentary. $90bn weekly drawdown suggests a correction, not yet a capitulation.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautiously constructive if oil stabilises and RBA pivots. Structural themes: energy transition (wind, LNG), AI capex cycle (despite slowdown calls), and superannuation reform. Housing correction may create first-home buyer demand inflection. Mining cap-raise cycle suggests a trough in junior exploration funding. Geopolitical risk (BRICS, Arctic shipping, Russia) adds a tail-risk premium.
